description: Flask-based web application running on localhost:8080 for loan management. The application handles user authentication, profile management, and loan calculation with potential vulnerabilities including SSTI in the /total_loan_payments endpoint, weak authentication without rate limiting or account lockout, and plaintext password storage in the database.

details.authentication: Session-based with user_id stored in Flask session

notes: Application includes known vulnerabilities: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) in /total_loan_payments endpoint using render_template_string(), weak authentication without brute-force protection, plaintext password storage, and potential authorization issues. Test account exists (test:test).
